evaluationBinding.note: The 124-case evaluation used this binary. The only subsequent candidate source change emits already-bounded decision evidence to the text trace; classifier and transport behavior were unchanged.

rootCauseProbe.finding: The route-name phrase biased the raw choice toward Sol; removing it produced a low-confidence raw XHigh choice, while a generic irreversible-effect paraphrase strongly selected XHigh. This supports the generic criteria boundary and does not establish a provider defect.
